name: send_escalation_email
description: Sends a citizen's complaint or case-specific inquiry to the Zakat Fund complaints team by email. The recipient address is fixed by the backend and cannot be set here. Call only after the user has reviewed the summary and explicitly confirmed sending, and only once per confirmed request. Returns {"status": "sent", "reference": "..."} on success or {"status": "failed", "error": "..."} on failure.

request_type.description: complaint = شكوى؛ inquiry = استفسار خاص أو غير مذكور في اللائحة؛ file_follow_up = متابعة ملف أو طلب إعانة
